rationale: A runs a memoized search over sorted count tuples. It has a clear docstring explaining why it is enough to take books from the largest stacks, and it is correct by construction for any basket. B uses a greedy loop plus a hand-tuned rule that prefers a group of four over five when counts[4] < counts[2]. That rule is clever and commented, but it is harder to check, rests on a special-case insight, and is not obviously optimal for every basket. B also shadows the function name `total` with a local variable. A's approach is more robust and principled, with about the same complexity.
